constraints: Keep provider.runtime, Globals.Function.Runtime, per-function Runtime, and Terraform aws_lambda_function.runtime on one AWS Lambda runtime identifier that AWS still supports.
Raising the managed runtime can require .NET target framework and package updates; confirm the project targets the replacement before deploying.

steps.instructions: Change the reported Runtime (or provider.runtime / terraform runtime) from dotnet5.0 to a supported AWS Lambda .NET identifier (see the replacement).
steps.title: Raise the AWS Lambda runtime

steps.instructions: Update every other SAM/CloudFormation Globals or function Runtime, serverless.yml provider or function runtime, Terraform aws_lambda_function.runtime, and CI deploy config that still pins dotnet5.0.
steps.title: Align other runtime surfaces

verification.command: sam validate || serverless print || terraform validate
verification.purpose: Validate the updated SAM, Serverless Framework, or Terraform declaration before deploy.

rules.summary: The AWS Lambda runtimes table lists dotnet5.0 under Deprecated runtimes with deprecation date 2022-05-10. AWS no longer applies security or other updates to that managed runtime.
rules.title: AWS Lambda .NET 5 (container only) runtime is end-of-life
